title: DHII Engine architecture freeze with Tasks 01-04 creation foundations
summary: Tasks 01-04 accepted: the repo now has a frozen DHII Engine roadmap plus typed, rulebook-backed home-world, background, and role foundations, explainable aptitude composition, and a typed in-memory creation draft aggregate that safely recomposes canonical selections without stale downstream choice state. Validation is green locally, including full make ci and coverage-policy checks after draft-specific regression hardening.
